caseNameFull: United Steelworkers of America, AFL-CIO-CLC v. Flowers

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1034.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Isaac N. Groner, Esquire, of Washington, D. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondents in this case.
